verses.original: Ὡς οὖν ἔγνω ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὅτι Ἰησοῦς πλείονας μαθητὰς ποιεῖ καὶ βαπτίζει ἢ Ἰωάννης
verses.transliteration: Hōs oun egnō ho Iēsous hoti ēkousan hoi Pharisaioi hoti Iēsous pleionas mathētas poiei kai baptizei ē Iōannēs
verses.literal: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, o Senhor soube que os fariseus tinham ouvido dizer que ele, Jesus, fazia e batizava mais discípulos que João

verses.original: καίτοιγε Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς οὐκ ἐβάπτιζεν ἀλλ’ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kaitoige Iēsous autos ouk ebaptizen all’ hoi mathētai autou
verses.literal: (although it was not Jesus who baptized but His disciples)
verses.literalPt: (se bem que Jesus mesmo não batizasse, mas sim seus discípulos),

verses.original: ἀφῆκεν τὴν Ἰουδαίαν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν
verses.transliteration: aphēken tēn Ioudaian kai apēlthen palin eis tēn Galilaian
verses.literal: He left Judea and returned . . . to Galilee
verses.literalPt: deixou a Judeia e voltou para a Galileia.

verses.original: Ἔδει δὲ αὐτὸν διέρχεσθαι διὰ τῆς Σαμαρείας
verses.transliteration: Edei de auton dierchesthai dia tēs Samareias
verses.literal: Now He had to pass through Samaria
verses.literalPt: Precisava atravessar a Samaria.

verses.original: ἔρχεται οὖν εἰς πόλιν τῆς Σαμαρείας λεγομένην Συχὰρ πλησίον τοῦ χωρίου ὃ ἔδωκεν Ἰακὼβ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: erchetai oun eis polin tēs Samareias legomenēn Sychar plēsion tou chōriou ho edōken Iakōb tō Iōsēph tō huiō autou
verses.literal: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph
verses.literalPt: Chegou, pois, a uma cidade da Samaria, chamada Sicar, perto das terras que Jacó deu a seu filho José;

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ πηγὴ τοῦ Ἰακώβ ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς κεκοπιακὼς ἐκ τῆς ὁδοιπορίας ἐκαθέζετο οὕτως ἐπὶ τῇ πηγῇ ὥρα ἦν ὡς ἕκτη
verses.transliteration: ēn de ekei pēgē tou Iakōb ho oun Iēsous kekopiakōs ek tēs hodoiporias ekathezeto houtōs epi tē pēgē hōra ēn hōs hektē
verses.literal: Since Jacob’s well was there - Jesus weary from His journey sat down by the well It was about the sixth hour
verses.literalPt: era ali a fonte de Jacó. Cansado da viagem, estava Jesus assim sentado ao pé da fonte; era cerca da hora sexta.

verses.original: Ἔρχεται γυνὴ ἐκ τῆς Σαμαρείας ἀντλῆσαι ὕδωρ λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δός μοι πεῖν
verses.transliteration: Erchetai gynē ek tēs Samareias antlēsai hydōr legei autē ho Iēsous Dos moi pein
verses.literal: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water Jesus said to her Give Me a drink
verses.literalPt: Uma mulher da Samaria veio tirar água. Disse-lhe Jesus: Dá-me de beber.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπεληλύθεισαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἵνα τροφὰς ἀγοράσωσιν
verses.transliteration: hoi gar mathētai autou apelēlytheisan eis tēn polin hina trophas agorasōsin
verses.literal: ( His disciples had gone into the town to buy food
verses.literalPt: Pois seus discípulos tinham ido à cidade comprar alimentos.

verses.original: Λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ Σαμαρῖτις Πῶς σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ὢν παρ’ ἐμοῦ πεῖν αἰτεῖς γυναικὸς Σαμαρίτιδος οὔσης οὐ γὰρ συνχρῶνται Ἰουδαῖοι Σαμαρίταις
verses.transliteration: Legei oun autō hē gynē hē Samaritis Pōs sy Ioudaios ōn par’ emou pein aiteis gynaikos Samaritidos ousēs ou gar synchrōntai Ioudaioi Samaritais
verses.literal: You are a Jew said the - woman How can You ask for a drink from me a Samaritan woman (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe, então, a mulher samaritana: Como, sendo tu judeu, pedes de beber a mim, que sou mulher samaritana? Os judeus não se comunicam com os samaritanos.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Εἰ ᾔδεις τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ λέγων σοι Δός μοι πεῖν σὺ ἂν ᾔτησας αὐτὸν καὶ ἔδωκεν ἄν σοι ὕδωρ ζῶν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autē Ei ēdeis tēn dōrean tou Theou kai tis estin ho legōn soi Dos moi pein sy an ētēsas auton kai edōken an soi hydōr zōn
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . . . . . . . If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for . . . a drink you would have asked Him and He would have given you living water
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se tivesses conhecido o dom de Deus, e quem é o que te diz: Dá-me de beber, tu lhe terias pedido, e ele te haveria dado água viva.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή Κύριε οὔτε ἄντλημα ἔχεις καὶ τὸ φρέαρ ἐστὶν βαθύ πόθεν οὖν ἔχεις τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ζῶν
verses.transliteration: Legei autō hē gynē Kyrie oute antlēma echeis kai to phrear estin bathy pothen oun echeis to hydōr to zōn
verses.literal: Sir the woman replied You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep Where then will You get this living water
verses.literalPt: Ela lhe respondeu: Senhor, não tens com que a tirar, e o poço é fundo; donde, pois, tens essa água viva?

verses.original: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἰακώβ ὃς ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν τὸ φρέαρ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔπιεν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θρέμματα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: mē sy meizōn ei tou patros hēmōn Iakōb hos edōken hēmin to phrear kai autos ex autou epien kai hoi huioi autou kai ta thremmata autou
verses.literal: Are . . . You greater than our father Jacob who gave us this well and drank from it himself as did his sons and his livestock
verses.literalPt: És tu, porventura, maior que nosso pai Jacó, que nos deu este poço, do qual ele bebeu, e seus filhos e os seus gados?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Πᾶς ὁ πίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος τούτου διψήσει πάλιν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autē Pas ho pinōn ek tou hydatos toutou dipsēsei palin
verses.literal: Jesus - said to her Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again
verses.literalPt: Replicou-lhe Jesus: Todo o que bebe desta água tornará a ter sede;

verses.original: ὃς δ’ ἂν πίῃ ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος οὗ ἐγὼ δώσω αὐτῷ οὐ μὴ διψήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀλλὰ τὸ ὕδωρ ὃ δώσω αὐτῷ γενήσεται ἐν αὐτῷ πηγὴ ὕδατος ἁλλομένου εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: hos d’ an piē ek tou hydatos hou egō dōsō autō ou mē dipsēsei eis ton aiōna alla to hydōr ho dōsō autō genēsetai en autō pēgē hydatos hallomenou eis zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: But whoever . . . drinks the water I give him will never thirst . . . . . . . . . Indeed the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life
verses.literalPt: mas quem beber da água que eu lhe der nunca mais terá sede; pelo contrário, a água que eu lhe der virá a ser nele uma fonte de água que mana para a vida eterna.

verses.original: Λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνή Κύριε δός μοι τοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ ἵνα μὴ διψῶ μηδὲ διέρχωμαι ἐνθάδε ἀντλεῖν
verses.transliteration: Legei pros auton hē gynē Kyrie dos moi touto to hydōr hina mē dipsō mēde dierchōmai enthade antlein
verses.literal: The woman said to Him Sir give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, dá-me dessa água, para que eu não tenha mais sede, nem venha aqui tirá-la.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῇ Ὕπαγε φώνησον τὸν ἄνδρα σου καὶ ἐλθὲ ἐνθάδε
verses.transliteration: Legei autē Hypage phōnēson ton andra sou kai elthe enthade
verses.literal: Jesus told her Go call your husband and come back
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe ele: Vai, chama teu marido e vem cá.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη ἡ γυνὴ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Οὐκ ἔχω ἄνδρα Λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Καλῶς εἶπας ὅτι Ἄνδρα οὐκ ἔχω
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē hē gynē kai eipen autō Ouk echō andra Legei autē ho Iēsous Kalōs eipas hoti Andra ouk echō
verses.literal: I have no husband the woman replied . . . . . . . . . Jesus said to her You are correct to say that you have no husband
verses.literalPt: Respondeu a mulher: Não tenho marido. Replicou-lhe Jesus: Disseste bem que não tens marido;

verses.original: πέντε γὰρ ἄνδρας ἔσχες καὶ νῦν ὃν ἔχεις οὐκ ἔστιν σου ἀνήρ τοῦτο ἀληθὲς εἴρηκας
verses.transliteration: pente gar andras esches kai nyn hon echeis ouk estin sou anēr touto alēthes eirēkas
verses.literal: In fact you have had five husbands and the man you now have . . . is not your husband You have spoken truthfully
verses.literalPt: porque cinco maridos tiveste, e o que agora tens não é teu marido; isso disseste com verdade.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή Κύριε θεωρῶ ὅτι προφήτης εἶ σύ
verses.transliteration: Legei autō hē gynē Kyrie theōrō hoti prophētēs ei sy
verses.literal: Sir the woman said I see that You are a prophet
verses.literalPt: Senhor, disse-lhe a mulher, vejo que tu és profeta.

verses.original: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ προσεκύνησαν καὶ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐστὶν ὁ τόπος ὅπου προσκυνεῖν δεῖ
verses.transliteration: hoi pateres hēmōn en tō orei toutō prosekynēsan kai hymeis legete hoti en Hierosolymois estin ho topos hopou proskynein dei
verses.literal: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Nossos pais adoraram neste monte; e vós dizeis que em Jerusalém é o lugar onde se deve adorar.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πίστευέ μοι γύναι ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὔτε ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ οὔτε ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις προσκυνήσετε τῷ Πατρί
verses.transliteration: Legei autē ho Iēsous Pisteue moi gynai hoti erchetai hōra hote oute en tō orei toutō oute en Hierosolymois proskynēsete tō Patri
verses.literal: Believe Me woman Jesus replied - a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, crê-me, a hora vem em que nem neste monte, nem em Jerusalém adorareis o Pai.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς προσκυνεῖτε ὃ οὐκ οἴδατε ἡμεῖς προσκυνοῦμεν ὃ οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἡ σωτηρία ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: hymeis proskyneite ho ouk oidate hēmeis proskynoumen ho oidamen hoti hē sōtēria ek tōn Ioudaiōn estin
verses.literal: You worship what you do not know we worship what we do know for salvation is from the Jews
verses.literalPt: Vós adorais o que não conheceis, nós adoramos o que conhecemos, pois a salvação vem dos judeus.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν ὅτε οἱ ἀληθινοὶ προσκυνηταὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ Πατρὶ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ καὶ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ τοιούτους ζητεῖ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: alla erchetai hōra kai nyn estin hote hoi alēthinoi proskynētai proskynēsousin tō Patri en pneumati kai alētheia kai gar ho Patēr toioutous zētei tous proskynountas auton
verses.literal: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him
verses.literalPt: Mas a hora vem e agora é, em que os verdadeiros adoradores adorarão o Pai em espírito e em verdade; porque são estes que o Pai procura para seus adoradores.

verses.original: Πνεῦμα ὁ Θεός καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτὸν ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ δεῖ προσκυνεῖν
verses.transliteration: Pneuma ho Theos kai tous proskynountas auton en pneumati kai alētheia dei proskynein
verses.literal: God is Spirit and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth
verses.literalPt: Deus é espírito; e é necessário que os que o adoram o adorem em espírito e em verdade.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή Οἶδα ὅτι Μεσσίας ἔρχεται ὁ λεγόμενος Χριστός ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος ἀναγγελεῖ ἡμῖν ἅπαντα
verses.transliteration: Legei autō hē gynē Oida hoti Messias erchetai ho legomenos Christos hotan elthē ekeinos anangelei hēmin hapanta
verses.literal: The woman said I know that Messiah ( called Christ) is coming When He comes He will explain everything to us
verses.literalPt: Eu sei, respondeu a mulher, que vem o Messias (que se chama Cristo); quando ele vier, anunciar-nos-á todas as coisas.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ λαλῶν σοι
verses.transliteration: Legei autē ho Iēsous Egō eimi ho lalōn soi
verses.literal: Jesus answered I who speak to you am He
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu o sou, eu que falo contigo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἦλθαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ὅτι μετὰ γυναικὸς ἐλάλει οὐδεὶς μέντοι εἶπεν Τί ζητεῖς ἢ Τί λαλεῖς μετ’ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai epi toutō ēlthan hoi mathētai autou kai ethaumazon hoti meta gynaikos elalei oudeis mentoi eipen Ti zēteis ē Ti laleis met’ autēs
verses.literal: Just then . . . . . . His disciples returned and were surprised that He was speaking with a woman But no one asked Him What do You want from her or Why are You talking with her
verses.literalPt: Nisso, chegaram os seus discípulos e maravilhavam-se de que estivesse falando com uma mulher. Ninguém, todavia, lhe perguntou: Que procuras ou que falas com ela?

verses.original: Ἀφῆκεν οὖν τὴν ὑδρίαν αὐτῆς ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: Aphēken oun tēn hydrian autēs hē gynē kai apēlthen eis tēn polin kai legei tois anthrōpois
verses.literal: Then the woman left her water jar went back into the town and said to the people
verses.literalPt: A mulher deixou o cântaro, foi à cidade e disse ao povo:

verses.original: Δεῦτε ἴδετε ἄνθρωπον ὃς εἶπέν μοι πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησα μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: Deute idete anthrōpon hos eipen moi panta hosa epoiēsa mēti houtos estin ho Christos
verses.literal: Come see a man who told me everything I ever did Could this be the Christ
verses.literalPt: Vinde ver um homem que me contou tudo o que fiz. Será este, porventura, o Cristo?

verses.original: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: exēlthon ek tēs poleōs kai ērchonto pros auton
verses.literal: So they left . . . the town and made their way toward Jesus
verses.literalPt: Saíram da cidade e vieram ter com ele.

verses.original: Ἐν τῷ μεταξὺ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες Ῥαββί φάγε
verses.transliteration: En tō metaxy ērōtōn auton hoi mathētai legontes Rhabbi phage
verses.literal: Meanwhile . . . . . . the disciples urged Him Rabbi eat something
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, os discípulos lhe rogavam, dizendo: Mestre, come.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐγὼ βρῶσιν ἔχω φαγεῖν ἣν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Egō brōsin echō phagein hēn hymeis ouk oidate
verses.literal: But He told them I have food to eat that you know nothing about
verses.literalPt: Mas ele lhes respondeu: Eu para comer tenho um manjar que vós não conheceis.

verses.original: Ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ πρὸς ἀλλήλους Μή τις ἤνεγκεν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: Elegon oun hoi mathētai pros allēlous Mē tis ēnenken autō phagein
verses.literal: So the disciples asked one another Could someone have brought Him food
verses.literalPt: Os discípulos, pois, diziam uns aos outros: Porventura, alguém lhe trouxe de comer?

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐμὸν βρῶμά ἐστιν ἵνα ποιήσω τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με καὶ τελειώσω αὐτοῦ τὸ ἔργον
verses.transliteration: Legei autois ho Iēsous Emon brōma estin hina poiēsō to thelēma tou pempsantos me kai teleiōsō autou to ergon
verses.literal: Jesus explained . . . My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: A minha comida é fazer eu a vontade daquele que me enviou e completar a sua obra.

verses.original: οὐχ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Ἔτι τετράμηνός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ θερισμὸς ἔρχεται ἰδοὺ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐπάρατε τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ θεάσασθε τὰς χώρας ὅτι λευκαί εἰσιν πρὸς θερισμόν ἤδη
verses.transliteration: ouch hymeis legete hoti Eti tetramēnos estin kai ho therismos erchetai idou legō hymin eparate tous ophthalmous hymōn kai theasasthe tas chōras hoti leukai eisin pros therismon ēdē
verses.literal: Do you not say There are still four months until . . . the harvest I tell you lift up your eyes and look at the fields for they are ripe for harvest
verses.literalPt: Não dizeis vós que ainda há quatro meses até a ceifa? Eu, porém, vos digo: Erguei os vossos olhos e contemplai estes campos, que estão brancos para a ceifa.

verses.original: Ὁ θερίζων μισθὸν λαμβάνει καὶ συνάγει καρπὸν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἵνα ὁ σπείρων ὁμοῦ χαίρῃ καὶ ὁ θερίζων
verses.transliteration: Ho therizōn misthon lambanei kai synagei karpon eis zōēn aiōnion hina ho speirōn homou chairē kai ho therizōn
verses.literal: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together
verses.literalPt: Quem ceifa já está recebendo salário e ajuntando fruto para a vida eterna, a fim de que o que semeia e o que ceifa, juntamente, se regozijem.

verses.original: ἐν γὰρ τούτῳ ὁ λόγος ἐστὶν ἀληθινὸς ὅτι Ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ σπείρων καὶ ἄλλος ὁ θερίζων
verses.transliteration: en gar toutō ho logos estin alēthinos hoti Allos estin ho speirōn kai allos ho therizōn
verses.literal: For in this case the saying - One sows and another reaps is true
verses.literalPt: Pois nisso é verdadeiro o ditado: Um é o que semeia, e outro, o que ceifa.

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς θερίζειν ὃ οὐχ ὑμεῖς κεκοπιάκατε ἄλλοι κεκοπιάκασιν καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν κόπον αὐτῶν εἰσεληλύθατε
verses.transliteration: egō apesteila hymas therizein ho ouch hymeis kekopiakate alloi kekopiakasin kai hymeis eis ton kopon autōn eiselēlythate
verses.literal: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for others have done the hard work and now you have taken up . . . their labor
verses.literalPt: Eu vos enviei a colher aquilo em que não tendes trabalhado; outros trabalharam, e vós tendes entrado no seu trabalho.

verses.original: Ἐκ δὲ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν τῶν Σαμαριτῶν διὰ τὸν λόγον τῆς γυναικὸς μαρτυρούσης ὅτι Εἶπέν μοι πάντα ἃ ἐποίησα
verses.transliteration: Ek de tēs poleōs ekeinēs polloi episteusan eis auton tōn Samaritōn dia ton logon tēs gynaikos martyrousēs hoti Eipen moi panta ha epoiēsa
verses.literal: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony He told me everything I ever did
verses.literalPt: Muitos samaritanos daquela cidade creram nele por causa das palavras da mulher, que testificara: Ele disse-me tudo o que fiz.

verses.original: ὡς οὖν ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Σαμαρῖται ἠρώτων αὐτὸν μεῖναι παρ’ αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ δύο ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: hōs oun ēlthon pros auton hoi Samaritai ērōtōn auton meinai par’ autois kai emeinen ekei dyo hēmeras
verses.literal: So when the Samaritans came to Him they asked Him to stay with them and He stayed . . . two days
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, esses samaritanos vieram ter com Jesus, pediram-lhe que ficasse com eles; e passou ali dois dias.

verses.original: Καὶ πολλῷ πλείους ἐπίστευσαν διὰ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai pollō pleious episteusan dia ton logon autou
verses.literal: And many more believed because of His message
verses.literalPt: Muitos mais creram por causa das palavras de Jesus

verses.original: τῇ τε γυναικὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὐκέτι διὰ τὴν σὴν λαλιὰν πιστεύομεν αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκηκόαμεν καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ Σωτὴρ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: tē te gynaiki elegon hoti Ouketi dia tēn sēn lalian pisteuomen autoi gar akēkoamen kai oidamen hoti houtos estin alēthōs ho Sōtēr tou kosmou
verses.literal: They said to the woman We now believe not only because of your words we have heard for ourselves and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world
verses.literalPt: e diziam à mulher: Não é mais pelas tuas palavras que nós cremos; mas porque nós mesmos temos ouvido e sabemos que este é verdadeiramente o Salvador do mundo.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς δύο ἡμέρας ἐξῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν
verses.transliteration: Meta de tas dyo hēmeras exēlthen ekeithen eis tēn Galilaian
verses.literal: After two days Jesus left . . . for Galilee
verses.literalPt: Depois destes dois dias, partiu dali para a Galileia.

verses.original: αὐτὸς γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐμαρτύρησεν ὅτι προφήτης ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ πατρίδι τιμὴν οὐκ ἔχει
verses.transliteration: autos gar Iēsous emartyrēsen hoti prophētēs en tē idia patridi timēn ouk echei
verses.literal: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown
verses.literalPt: Pois Jesus mesmo testificou que um profeta não recebe honra em sua terra.

verses.original: ὅτε οὖν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἐδέξαντο αὐτὸν οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι πάντα ἑωρακότες ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ καὶ αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν
verses.transliteration: hote oun ēlthen eis tēn Galilaian edexanto auton hoi Galilaioi panta heōrakotes hosa epoiēsen en Hierosolymois en tē heortē kai autoi gar ēlthon eis tēn heortēn
verses.literal: Yet when He arrived - the Galileans welcomed Him They had seen all the great things . . . He had done in Jerusalem at the feast for they had gone there as well
verses.literalPt: Assim, quando chegou a Galileia, os galileus o receberam bem, porque tinham visto tudo o que ele fizera em Jerusalém na ocasião da festa; pois eles também foram à festa.

verses.original: Ἦλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ὅπου ἐποίησεν τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον Καὶ ἦν τις βασιλικὸς οὗ ὁ υἱὸς ἠσθένει ἐν Καφαρναούμ
verses.transliteration: Ēlthen oun palin eis tēn Kana tēs Galilaias hopou epoiēsen to hydōr oinon Kai ēn tis basilikos hou ho huios ēsthenei en Kapharnaoum
verses.literal: So once again He came to Cana in Galilee where He had turned the water into wine And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum
verses.literalPt: Voltou, então, a Caná da Galileia, onde fizera da água vinho. Ali se achava um oficial do rei, cujo filho estava doente em Cafarnaum.

verses.original: οὗτος ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἥκει ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἠρώτα ἵνα καταβῇ καὶ ἰάσηται αὐτοῦ τὸν υἱόν ἤμελλεν γὰρ ἀποθνήσκειν
verses.transliteration: houtos akousas hoti Iēsous hēkei ek tēs Ioudaias eis tēn Galilaian apēlthen pros auton kai ērōta hina katabē kai iasētai autou ton huion ēmellen gar apothnēskein
verses.literal: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son who was about to die
verses.literalPt: Esse homem, ao saber que Jesus tinha vindo da Judeia para a Galileia, foi ter com ele e rogou-lhe que descesse para curar seu filho; porque estava à morte.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς αὐτόν Ἐὰν μὴ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἴδητε οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun ho Iēsous pros auton Ean mē sēmeia kai terata idēte ou mē pisteusēte
verses.literal: Jesus said to him Unless . . . you people see signs and wonders you will never believe
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Se não virdes milagres e prodígios, de modo algum crereis.

verses.original: Λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλικός Κύριε κατάβηθι πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν τὸ παιδίον μου
verses.transliteration: Legei pros auton ho basilikos Kyrie katabēthi prin apothanein to paidion mou
verses.literal: Sir the official said - come down before my child dies
verses.literalPt: Rogou-lhe o oficial: Desce, Senhor, antes que meu filho morra.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πορεύου ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ Ἐπίστευσεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐπορεύετο
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Poreuou ho huios sou zē Episteusen ho anthrōpos tō logō hon eipen autō ho Iēsous kai eporeueto
verses.literal: Go said Jesus Your son will live The man took Jesus at His word . . . . . . . . . . . . and departed
verses.literalPt: Vai, disse Jesus; teu filho vive. O homem creu na palavra que Jesus lhe dissera e retirou-se.

verses.original: ἤδη δὲ αὐτοῦ καταβαίνοντος οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι ὁ παῖς αὐτοῦ ζῇ
verses.transliteration: ēdē de autou katabainontos hoi douloi autou hypēntēsan autō legontes hoti ho pais autou zē
verses.literal: And while he was still on the way his servants met him with the news that his boy was alive
verses.literalPt: Já ele descia, quando os seus servos lhe vieram ao encontro, dizendo que o seu filho vivia.

verses.original: Ἐπύθετο οὖν τὴν ὥραν παρ’ αὐτῶν ἐν ᾗ κομψότερον ἔσχεν εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐχθὲς ὥραν ἑβδόμην ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν ὁ πυρετός
verses.transliteration: Epytheto oun tēn hōran par’ autōn en hē kompsoteron eschen eipan oun autō hoti Echthes hōran hebdomēn aphēken auton ho pyretos
verses.literal: So he inquired as to . . . . . . the hour when his son had recovered . . . and they told him The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhes, então, a que hora ele se sentira melhor. Eles lhe responderam: Ontem, à sétima hora, a febre o deixou.

verses.original: Ἔγνω οὖν ὁ πατὴρ ὅτι ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐν ᾗ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ καὶ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ οἰκία αὐτοῦ ὅλη
verses.transliteration: Egnō oun ho patēr hoti en ekeinē tē hōra en hē eipen autō ho Iēsous Ho huios sou zē kai episteusen autos kai hē oikia autou holē
verses.literal: Then the father realized that this was the very . . . hour in which Jesus had told him Your son will live And he and all his household believed
verses.literalPt: Reconheceu o pai ser aquela a mesma hora em que Jesus dissera: Teu filho vive; e creu ele e toda a sua casa.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ πάλιν δεύτερον σημεῖον ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλθὼν ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν
verses.transliteration: Touto de palin deuteron sēmeion epoiēsen ho Iēsous elthōn ek tēs Ioudaias eis tēn Galilaian
verses.literal: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee
verses.literalPt: Este foi o segundo milagre que Jesus fez, depois de vir da Judeia para a Galileia.
